# ---------------------------------------------------------------- governments (ROM scope)
wif_rom_king_michael_rules = {
	set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
	add_popularity = { ideology = neutrality popularity = 0.20 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = wif_rom_michael_i } } recruit_character = wif_rom_michael_i }
	promote_character = wif_rom_michael_i
	set_country_flag = wif_rom_gov_king
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- sides (ROM scope)
wif_rom_join_axis = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER GER = { is_faction_leader = yes } }
		GER = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ITA ITA = { is_faction_leader = yes } }
		ITA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}
wif_rom_join_allies = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { any_country = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ENG tag = FRA tag = USA } } }
		random_country = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes OR = { tag = ENG tag = FRA tag = USA } } add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}
wif_rom_join_rome = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = ITA ITA = { is_faction_leader = yes } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = ITA } }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		ITA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}
wif_rom_join_ofn = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = USA USA = { is_faction_leader = yes } NOT = { is_in_faction_with = USA } }
		if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
		USA = { add_to_faction = ROOT }
	}
}
wif_rom_leave_germany = {
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = GER } leave_faction = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_subject_of = GER } GER = { end_puppet = ROOT } }
}

# The Turn of the Tide: out of the Axis, peace with the Soviet side, into the Allies' war on Germany.
wif_rom_turn_of_the_tide = {
	set_country_flag = wif_rom_turned
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
		white_peace = { tag = ROOT }
	}
	wif_rom_join_allies = yes
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER NOT = { has_war_with = GER } }
		declare_war_on = { target = GER type = annex_everything }
	}
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Soviet flip
# ROM scope. At war with the Soviet Union, 25% surrender inside two years of that war starting.
wif_rom_soviet_flip = {
	set_global_flag = wif_rom_flipped
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } OVERLORD = { end_puppet = ROOT } }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
		white_peace = { tag = ROOT }
	}
	set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
	set_popularities = { communism = 60 neutrality = 25 democratic = 10 fascism = 5 }
	load_focus_tree = { tree = wif_rom_com_focus keep_completed = no }
	add_ideas = wif_romc_colony_idea
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = SOV }
		SOV = {
			puppet = ROM
			# autonomy_colony needs Together for Victory in vanilla; without it ROM stays an ordinary puppet
			# (the Soviet Colony spirit carries the extraction either way).
			set_autonomy = { target = ROM autonomy_state = autonomy_colony }
			country_event = { id = wif_rom.10 days = 1 }
		}
		# The colony fights the Soviet Union's wars.
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_war_with = SOV NOT = { tag = ROM } }
			ROM = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = SOV enemy = PREV hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
		}
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rom.11 days = 1 }
}

		recruit_character = ROM_constantin_ion_parhon
	}
	if = { limit = { has_character = ROM_constantin_ion_parhon } promote_character = ROM_constantin_ion_parhon }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the carve-up
# ROM scope: Romania capitulated to Germany or its faction - it leaves the war entirely,
# Hungary (holding Northern Transylvania) takes all of Transylvania, the rest is a German puppet.
wif_rom_carved_up = {
	set_global_flag = wif_rom_carved
	if = { limit = { is_in_faction = yes } leave_faction = yes }
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_war_with = ROOT }
		white_peace = { tag = ROOT }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = HUN 76 = { is_owned_by = HUN } }
		84 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT } transfer_state_to = HUN } }
		83 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT } transfer_state_to = HUN } }
		76 = { if = { limit = { is_owned_by = ROOT } transfer_state_to = HUN } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = GER }
		GER = { puppet = ROM }
	}
	news_event = { id = wif_rom.20 days = 1 }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the Transylvanian war
# ROM scope.
wif_rom_tw_start = {
	set_global_flag = wif_rom_tw_active
	every_country = {
		limit = { OR = { has_war_with = ROM has_war_with = HUN } }
		set_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar
	}
	set_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar
	HUN = { set_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar }
	declare_war_on = { target = HUN type = take_state_focus generator = { 76 } }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rom_tw_war_idea days = 60 }
	country_event = { id = wif_rom.35 days = 60 }
	news_event = { id = wif_rom.33 days = 1 }
}

# ROM scope, daily while the war is on: no one else may join it.
wif_rom_tw_enforce = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_war_with = ROM NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar } }
		white_peace = { tag = ROM }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_war_with = HUN NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar } }
		white_peace = { tag = HUN }
	}
}

wif_rom_tw_end = {
	clr_global_flag = wif_rom_tw_active
	every_country = { limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar } clr_country_flag = wif_rom_tw_prewar }
}

# Any scope: Romania wins - Northern Transylvania (and whatever else of Transylvania Hungary holds) back, cored.
wif_rom_tw_won = {
	wif_rom_tw_end = yes
	if = { limit = { ROM = { has_war_with = HUN } } ROM = { white_peace = { tag = HUN } } }
	if = { limit = { 76 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 76 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 76 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 76 = { add_core_of = ROM } } if = { limit = { 84 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 84 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 84 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 84 = { add_core_of = ROM } } if = { limit = { 83 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 83 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 83 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 83 = { add_core_of = ROM } }
	ROM = { news_event = { id = wif_rom.36 days = 1 } }
}

# Any scope: Hungary holds.
wif_rom_tw_lost = {
	wif_rom_tw_end = yes
	if = { limit = { HUN = { has_war_with = ROM } } HUN = { white_peace = { tag = ROM } } }
	ROM = {
		add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rom_cluj_humiliation_idea days = 365 }
		news_event = { id = wif_rom.37 days = 1 }
	}
}

# ROM scope: Transylvania Returned (the Allied victory).
wif_rom_transylvania_returned = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = HUN HUN = { OR = { has_capitulated = yes is_in_faction_with = GER is_subject_of = GER } } }
		if = { limit = { 76 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 76 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 76 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 76 = { add_core_of = ROM } } if = { limit = { 84 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 84 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 84 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 84 = { add_core_of = ROM } } if = { limit = { 83 = { is_owned_by = HUN } } 83 = { transfer_state_to = ROM } } if = { limit = { 83 = { is_owned_by = ROM } } 83 = { add_core_of = ROM } }
	}
	else = {
		add_state_claim = 76
		add_state_claim = 84
		add_state_claim = 83
	}
}

# on_capitulation_immediate: ROOT capitulated, FROM the winner.
wif_rom_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = { tag = HUN FROM = { tag = ROM } has_global_flag = wif_rom_tw_active }
		wif_rom_tw_won = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tag = ROM FROM = { tag = HUN } has_global_flag = wif_rom_tw_active }
		wif_rom_tw_lost = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			tag = ROM
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rom_flipped }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rom_carved }
			country_exists = GER
			NOT = { is_in_faction_with = GER }
			NOT = { is_subject_of = GER }
			FROM = { OR = { tag = GER is_in_faction_with = GER } }
		}
		wif_rom_carved_up = yes
	}
}

# ROM scope, weekly.
wif_rom_weekly = {
	# The two-year clock for the Soviet flip starts with the war.
	if = {
		limit = { has_war_with = SOV NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_sov_war } }
		set_country_flag = wif_rom_sov_war
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = SOV } has_country_flag = wif_rom_sov_war }
		clr_country_flag = wif_rom_sov_war
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = SOV
			has_country_flag = { flag = wif_rom_sov_war days < 730 }
			surrender_progress > 0.25
			NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_rom_flipped }
			NOT = { has_government = communism }
		}
		wif_rom_soviet_flip = yes
	}
	# Deny Ploiesti: Germany at war with us - the fields are wrecked for a year.
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_deny_ploiesti NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_ploiesti_wrecked } has_war_with = GER }
		set_country_flag = wif_rom_ploiesti_wrecked
		add_resource = { type = oil amount = -30 state = 46 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = wif_rom_ploiesti_wrecked_idea days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = { flag = wif_rom_ploiesti_wrecked days > 365 } NOT = { has_country_flag = wif_rom_ploiesti_repaired } }
		set_country_flag = wif_rom_ploiesti_repaired
		add_resource = { type = oil amount = 30 state = 46 }
	}
}

wif_rom_daily = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_flag = wif_rom_tw_active } wif_rom_tw_enforce = yes }
}
